verdict.rationale: Sift is a fraud-detection data platform, and while the axis of data retention/deletion control could plausibly apply (customers send PII/event data to Sift), no evidence pack item documents any retention policy, deletion API, data lifecycle controls, or privacy/compliance settings a user could configure; one community note even flags unresolved privacy/legal concerns about sending data to Sift with no indication these were addressed via retention/deletion controls.
